correctness.rationale: For every c>0, a two-by-two backward-generator boundary problem gives success P=1/(1+c) and the exact PGF H_c. A regular positive selfadjoint Robin-Dirichlet spectrum and genus-zero entire-function product prove the independent geometric-sum law; logarithmic expansion proves finite compound-Poisson jump mass c-log(1+c). A continuity theorem for Laplace transforms establishes M/c² convergence to an exponential series. The finite-c first two moments follow by exact differentiation, and a standalone checker passed 71 root, PGF, moment, limit and Monte Carlo consistency checks. The finite tests are not used as proofs of universal claims.

value.rationale: Conditioning on successful two-sided transmission of an active persistent particle makes internal reversal counts a naturally motivated transport observable. The positive geometric/compound-Poisson decomposition gives exact tail-probability and count statistics beyond the mean and the large-domain M~c² non-Gaussian law identifies a distinct fluctuation regime. This is not merely an arbitrary parameter restriction or a textbook first-passage mean. It is restricted to homogeneous symmetric velocities and rate and does not describe crossing time.
